description: Operational design domain (ODD) limits. A scenario matching ANY rule is out of scope: its failures are reported as SPURIOUS (a breach of a domain assumption), not as requirement violations. Edit freely; the human owns this file. The default rule matches nothing in old.bnf (max fog there is 50, which the REAL paper treats as realistic) - it is here to show the shape.

rules.name: extreme_fog
rules.reason: Visibility below what the perception ODD is meant to cover
